notablePrerequisites:
Divine Intervention has at least one intervention counter on it.
A player has a card in their graveyard with mana value equal to, or greater than, the number of intervention counters on Divine Intervention.
description:
Cast Cemetery Desecrator by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Cemetery Desecrator enters the battlefield, exiling a card from a graveyard with mana value equal to, or greater than, the number of intervention counters on Divine Intervention, and removing all intervention counters from Divine Intervention.
Divine Intervention's second ability triggers, causing the game to end in a draw.
